security_audit.summary: Four pipe-to-shell installation instructions are confirmed critical risks, and the manual installation uses a dynamic remote download URL. Most other alerts are documentation links, placeholders, Markdown syntax, or standard configuration paths. The skill also enables local-file uploads and authenticated external actions that require explicit user control.

remediation.issue: The installation instructions execute a remote script directly through a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace every pipe-to-shell command with a version-pinned download that users verify before execution.

remediation.issue: The manual installation derives a download URL from a remote manifest using shell text processing.
remediation.suggestion: Provide fixed release URLs and verify both checksums and signatures before extracting or installing a binary.

remediation.issue: Local paths are automatically uploaded to a remote service.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation for each upload, restrict allowed paths, and warn users never to provide credentials or private files.

remediation.issue: The broad belt command permission includes publishing, messaging, following, and deployment actions.
remediation.suggestion: Limit default permissions to read-only commands and require confirmation before every account-changing or public action.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends installing another skill through an unpinned npx command.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the package and skill version, document its source, and require user approval before installation.

content.user_title: Run Cloud AI Apps from the Command Line
content.value_statement: Cloud AI workflows often require different APIs and tools. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh CLI discovery, execution, and task tracking.
actual_capabilities: Search and filter the inference.sh public app catalog.
Inspect app details and generate sample input files.
Run image, video, audio, language, search, and 3D applications.
Upload local media files as inputs to supported cloud apps.
Submit asynchronous tasks and retrieve their status or results.
Guide authentication, shell completion, update, and deployment commands.
limitations: The inference.sh CLI, an account, network access, and available credits are required.
Prompts and selected local files are sent to remote services.
App availability, model versions, prices, and output quality depend on inference.sh.
Publishing, messaging, following, installation, and deployment actions require explicit user approval.

use_cases.title: Prototype Multimodal Features
use_cases.description: Find suitable image, video, language, or search apps and test them from a terminal workflow.

use_cases.title: Produce Media Assets
use_cases.description: Generate images, videos, speech, or 3D assets while tracking long-running cloud tasks.

use_cases.title: Operate Cloud AI Jobs
use_cases.description: Pin app versions, submit asynchronous runs, save results, and inspect failures in repeatable workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Find an App
prompt_templates.prompt: Search inference.sh for apps that can perform [task]. Compare the most relevant options and do not run anything yet.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect App Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [app name], summarize its required inputs, and generate a sample input file. Ask before changing any existing file.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Media Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Run [app name] with [prompt and settings]. If a local file is needed, show its path and request upload approval first.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Asynchronous Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a version-pinned workflow for [goal]. Submit without waiting, track the task, save results, and stop on authentication or quota errors.

output_examples.input: Find a fast image model for product concept art.
output: Reason: The catalog describes it as a fast FLUX option.
Next step: Inspect its current input schema before running.

output_examples.input: Prepare a video generation run from my local image.
output: Upload approval required for the selected local image path.
The run will begin only after approval and input validation.

output_examples.output: The task was submitted without waiting. Its task identifier is ready for status checks and result retrieval.

best_practices: Inspect each app schema and current version before preparing inputs.
Request explicit approval before uploads, installations, deployments, posts, messages, follows, or other external changes.
Use version pinning and save task identifiers for repeatable asynchronous workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not send credentials, private files, or unrelated workspace data as app inputs.
Do not execute pipe-to-shell installers or unverified dynamic download commands.
Do not assume model availability, pricing, quotas, or input schemas remain unchanged.

faq.question: What must I install?
faq.answer: You need the inference.sh belt CLI. Use a verified, version-pinned installation method instead of executing a remote script directly.

faq.question: How does authentication work?
faq.answer: Interactive login opens a browser. Automated environments can use INFSH_API_KEY, which should be stored in a protected secret manager.

faq.question: Can the skill use local files?
faq.answer: Yes. Supported app inputs can upload local paths, but every upload should require explicit approval.

faq.question: Which AI tasks are supported?
faq.answer: The catalog includes image, video, audio, language, search, 3D, and social automation apps. Availability can change.

faq.question: Can it manage long-running jobs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can submit without waiting, retrieve task status, and save returned results.

faq.question: Does it perform public or account-changing actions?
faq.answer: It can post content, use social actions, and deploy apps. These operations should never run without explicit user confirmation.
